ANSWER: The renamed/forked path is built by the function **`ConflictForkPath`** in **`pkg/sync/reconcile.go`** (defined at reconcile.go:45). It takes the original path plus the local `vault.TreeEntry`, delegates to the helper **`ConflictLocalPath`** (same file, reconcile.go:27) to produce the base `.conflict-local` name, then appends `-<hash8>` — the first 8 hex characters of the local entry's `PlaintextHash` — before the extension, yielding e.g. `ideas.conflict-local-1a2b3c4d.md`.

It is called from two places:
- **`ApplyConflictFailsafe`** in `pkg/sync/reconcile.go` (reconcile.go:204)
- **`HubSync`** in `pkg/sync/hub.go` (hub.go:198)
